text:
alina (PM): quick safeguard check before we hand the GA package off to sales/compliance. want a one-page customer-facing summary + internal checklist: SLA commitments, monitoring sampling, escalation path, pricing fallbacks, and dedicated-capacity handoff notes. keep it actionable.
hugo (SRE): SLO proposal: p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 400ms, availability >= 99.95%. add a short note on how we measure (synthetic canaries + production sampling) and where traces live.
ben (FinOps): pricing fallback options for pilots: (1) burst credit pool w/ surcharge multiplier, (2) throttled plan with lower unit price. will mock two example invoices and a short CSV with sensitivity to avg token length.
tess (ProdOps): handoff requirements for Dedicated: contact list for provisioning, expected warm-up time for reserved GPUs, and a short-run test that validates failover from hosted to dedicated without token loss. I'll schedule a 30m handover run.
maria (Docs): I'll draft the one-pager customer summary and an internal checklist page. need the exact phrasing for "error budget exhaustion" behavior and a short template for exception approvals.
sara (Support): Support asks: 1) one-line customer comms for outages, 2) triage checklist with required artifacts (trace IDs, request samples, model version), 3) owner roster for billing vs quality issues.
hugo (SRE): alerting rules to propose: p95 > 150ms for 5m, p99 > 400ms for 5m, burn_rate > 2 for 1h. plus an automated annotation when synthetic fails to meet p99 for 30m.
ben (FinOps): commercial rule: sustained burst >3x baseline for 15m => auto-throttle unless customer has burst credits. will supply contract wording and an opt-in checkbox for sales flow.
tess (ProdOps): will run a failover sim tomorrow 07:30 PT (reserved pool preemption + single-region blackout). output: latency delta, error rates, and a simple runbook snippet to reproduce.
maria (Docs): drafting pages: /docs/launch/customer-onepager.md, /docs/launch/internal-checklist.md, /docs/launch/dedicated-handoff.md. including example payloads and cost math.
sara (Support): scheduling a 30-min tabletop with oncall next week to exercise the triage flow and canned comms.
status-bot: Notice: synthetic-run scheduled 2024-07-11T08:00Z for 72h.
alina (PM): action items & owners: SRE (hugo) - alerts + sampling doc (EOD); ProdOps (tess) - failover sim + artifacts (tomorrow AM); FinOps (ben) - pricing examples + contract snippet (EOD); Docs (maria) - one-pager + checklist (EOD); Support (sara) - tabletop schedule (next week). reconvene in the 09:30 PT sync for sign-off.
hugo (SRE): I’ll post the alert rules JSON and the synthetic dashboard link when ready.
tess (ProdOps): adding test run to calendar and will attach perf traces.
ben (FinOps): uploading a tiny spreadsheet with two scenarios and margins.
maria (Docs): will open PRs and ping legal for the exception wording.
sara (Support): will circulate the dry-run invite and include a short feedback form for customer comms.
alina (PM): thanks. last note: include explicit rollback criteria (when to revert to previous model) and a short escalation path to commercial ops in the one-pager. :white_check_mark:
